title: Lebanon: Israeli army tells residents Tyre to evacuate, more and more people displaced
summary: Over the past week, Israel has issued evacuation warnings before launching heavy strikes on southern Lebanon and the southern suburbs of Beirut. The IDF estimates that more than 300,000 Lebanese civilians have so far evacuated their villages in southern Lebanon.
